rows.note: Firefox 155 real MediaRecorder (ogg/webm opus) -> decodeAudioData -> kernel transcription, English and Spanish, ask+download+ready flow, Send not driven. Limits: Firefox headless ignored deviceScaleFactor (devicePixelRatio 1 for both 'DPR' cells); Firefox cannot play a wav as fake mic, so the page's getUserMedia returns a captureStream of the recorded speech (everything after the stream is real).
